newsitem.title: USA: MDU Resources president to retire in 1998.
newsitem.headline: MDU Resources president to retire in 1998.

text.p: MDU Resources Group Inc said Wednesday that H.J. "Jim" Mellen Jr plans to retire from his position as president on March 31, 1998.
He will continue to serve on the board of directors.
MDU said the board will begin looking at potential candidates immediately and plans to name Mellen's successor later this year.
"We appreciate the lead time Jim has given us in announcing his retirement," John Schuchart, chairman, said in a statement.
Mellen joined MDU Reoures in July 1985 as a senior officer and became chief executive in January 1995.

MDU is a natural resource company comprised of an electric and natural gas utility, a natural gas transmission and marketing company, construction materials and mining operations, and an oil and natural gas acqusition, exploration and production company.
